description: IC-7300MK2 LAN audio, spectrum and receive tuning for Cardputer Zero

store.summary: Listen, tune, and view a live IC-7300MK2 waterfall over LAN.
store.description: Connect a Cardputer Zero to an Icom IC-7300MK2 on the same LAN for receive audio, a live spectrum and waterfall, and 1 kHz tuning. Select amateur-band presets with automatic LSB/USB mode selection, toggle noise reduction, adjust or mute volume, and start the antenna tuner. Requires a network-enabled IC-7300MK2 and its LAN account. T starts the antenna tuner and briefly transmits a tuning carrier. Radio credentials and volume settings are stored locally with user-only file permissions.
